interpretations: For each `event.status`, average the matched events’ event-level `remaining` averages and overspend-rate averages; divide the status’s average remaining by the average of all matched events’ event-level `remaining` averages.

For each `event.status`, average the matched events’ event-level figures; divide the status’s average remaining by the average `remaining` across all matched budget lines, weighting events by their number of lines.

For each `event.status`, average the matched events’ event-level figures; divide the status’s average remaining by the average of the status-level average remaining values, weighting statuses equally.

Use `budget.event_status` as the grouping status, assuming an event’s matched budget lines share one status; calculate the event-level figures and compare each status’s average remaining with the overall event-level average remaining.
For each `event.status`, calculate the event-level figures and express the comparison as the overall event-level average remaining divided by the status’s average remaining.
Group by `budget.event_status` even when an event’s budget lines have different statuses, counting that event’s figures once in each status represented by its lines.
queries:
WITH event_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(CASE WHEN b.remaining < 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS overspend_rate
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
)
SELECT
    status,
    AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
    AVG(overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate,
    AVG(avg_remaining) / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_metrics) AS remaining_ratio
FROM event_metrics
GROUP BY status

WITH event_remaining AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.status, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
)
SELECT status,
       AVG(remaining) / (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_ratio
FROM event_remaining
GROUP BY status

WITH event_remaining AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.status, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_average AS (
    SELECT status, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM event_remaining
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT status,
       avg_remaining / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM status_average) AS remaining_ratio
FROM status_average

WITH event_remaining AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        event_status,
        SUM(remaining) AS remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event, event_status
)
SELECT
    event_status,
    AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
    (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM event_remaining) AS overall_average_remaining
FROM event_remaining
GROUP BY event_status

WITH event_remaining AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.status, SUM(b.remaining) AS remaining
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
)
SELECT status,
       (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM event_remaining) / AVG(remaining) AS comparison
FROM event_remaining
GROUP BY status
